## Expected and observed behavior

Describe the difference and user impact/severity.

## Reproduction

Provide steps, affected version/commit, and relevant Windows/display conditions.

## Evidence and acceptance

Include relevant sanitized errors and how the fix will be verified. Keep secrets,
private reminders, and unauthorized screenshots out. Link the fixing PR when ready.
